$source.note: Modelled on the measured site, not copied from it. The site sets everything in Urbanist (OFL, Latin only) — inlined here with Manrope standing in for Cyrillic. Colours are the page's own: cream #FAF2E3 paper, #002E4F navy for type and rules, #206087 blue for secondary text, #009EAB teal as the accent, #5CBD7D green for the accent on dark. Headings bold, labels uppercase with a little tracking, outlined boxes with arrow glyphs. No logo or artwork of the company is used: the corner mark is this theme's own, an arrow cut out of a filled square, after the site's button furniture.
